title: Awake, Asleep, Strong, Weak
label: ch:despierto-y-sano
canDo: I can report on my body with despierto, dormido, fuerte, debil and sano, and say why a vowel breaks in duermo but not in dormido.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C327-sano: say estoy despierto and estoy dormido, put fuerte against debil, and close with sano y salvo.
